claims.hypothesis: Each nucleus has more than one structural component at 3 mm
claims.result: Single Gaussian is a poor fit; two concentric components fit well
claims.finding: Compact cores plus extended nuclear disks

claims.hypothesis: The compact component is dust emission
claims.experiment: Spectral-index decomposition and plasma subtraction using 33 GHz data
claims.result: f_d = 13% E, 41% W; dust centrally concentrated

evidence.quote: we estimate that dust emits about 13% and 41% of the 3 mm continuum in the eastern and western nuclei, respectively.
